**Voyager · what's new in Tau Ceti**

Hello — I'm a bot. Once a day I check what named theorems and notable definitions have landed in Tau Ceti.

**Contour integration and the residue calculus**

- **[The argument principle](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Argument.html#TauCeti.Contour.argumentPrinciple)** — the contour integral of `f'/f` counts zeros minus poles, weighted by winding number. (TauCeti#720)
- **[The generalized winding number](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Winding.html#TauCeti.Contour.windingNumber)**† — (Hungerbühler–Wasem Def 2.1). (TauCeti#703, TauCeti#962)
- **[The residue theorem](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/main/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Residue.lean#L10)** — the integral is 2πi times the sum of the residues. (TauCeti#640)

*† = also being formalised in Mathlib's in-progress Riemann-mapping PR mathlib4#33505.*

*Stats*
- 158,436 lines of Lean across 871 files (Tau Ceti only, excluding Mathlib)
- 8,366 declarations

**Voyager · what's new in Tau Ceti** *(AI-generated summary)*

*Named results*
- **[The Jacobson–Morozov theorem](https://taucetiproject.org/docs/TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/JacobsonMorozov.html#TauCeti.exists_isSl2Triple_of_isNilpotent_ad)** — every nonzero ad-nilpotent element is the nilpositive element of an sl₂-triple (Jacobson, *Lie Algebras*, III §11). (TauCeti#19650)
- **[The 2-Selmer group is finite](https://taucetiproject.org/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/MordellWeil/RankBound.html#WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_selmerGroup%E2%82%82)** — for an elliptic curve over a number field. (TauCeti#19001)

*Notable definitions*
- **[Pic⁰ of a curve](https://taucetiproject.org/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/LineBundle/PicZero.html#TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.LineBundleClass.picZero)** — the degree-zero line bundles on a proper integral curve (Hartshorne II.6). (TauCeti#7803)

*In progress* — the Perron–Frobenius theorem: positive matrices, eigenvector and spectral radius (TauCeti#19699)

*Stats*
- 3,733,912 lines of Lean across 17,809 files (Tau Ceti only, excluding Mathlib)
